Definition: Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Naamah = "loveliness"; n pr f; 1) daughter of Lamech by his wife Zillah and sister of Tubal-cain in the days before the flood; 2) the Ammonite wife of Solomon and mother of king Rehoboam of Judah; n pr f loc; 3) a town in the lowlands of Judah in Philistia
